title: Roast rhubarb and ricotta on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Rhubarb, orange, honey, hazelnuts, bread, ricotta and cinnamon are all ordinary whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Forced rhubarb, ricotta, hazelnuts and wholemeal bread are all stocked by Tesco and its rivals in January at everyday prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a frying pan and a toaster, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: 400g rhubarb roasted at 200°C for 12 to 15 minutes with orange and honey, served over eight slices of ricotta toast, makes a sensible breakfast for four.

honest_times.reason: Trimming rhubarb, zesting an orange, toasting nuts and making toast fits about 10 active minutes, with the 15-minute roast matching the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the cinnamon appear in the steps, and 'wholemeal bread' matches the bread id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early forced rhubarb, warm from the oven with clementine-season citrus, is the clear centre of a fitting New Year's Day breakfast.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with ricotta, fruit and nuts is a proper, appealing breakfast with protein and only modest added honey.
